## Test scope (from analysis context)

**Coverage & effort (as supplied)**
- Coverage estimate: 0.818 (≈82%)
- Effort: ~2.18 hours
- P1 test count: 11

**P1 tests (IDs, titles, covered components)**
- TC-022 — Token introspection rejects expired and revoked sessions — authentication-service
- TC-026 — Gateway card status route enforces the required authorization scope — api-gateway
- TC-021 — Biometric login verifies a device-bound challenge before issuing a token — authentication-service
- TC-025 — Gateway routes payment requests with the original correlation identifier — api-gateway
- TC-046 — Mobile card freeze propagates through gateway to card lifecycle state — api-gateway, authentication-service, mobile-banking
- TC-048 — Biometric challenge completion creates an authorized mobile session — api-gateway, authentication-service, mobile-banking
- TC-059 — ATM and branch servicing keep existing terminal and staff session behavior — api-gateway, atm, authentication-service, branch-portal (automation_candidate: false)
- TC-051 — Step-up proof cannot be replayed across devices or different card actions — authentication-service, mobile-banking
- TC-052 — Gateway denies card controls when token introspection is unavailable — api-gateway, authentication-service
- TC-054 — Privileged limit changes require authorized staff scope and an audit event — audit-db, authentication-service
- TC-055 — Biometric enrollment rejects mismatched device keys and revoked challenges — authentication-service, mobile-banking

**Gap to note**
- None of the supplied P1 tests cover `document-service`, the only directly changed service. The requirement's own verification points (footer text, layout fit on every page including multi-page statements, unchanged render payload and template selection contracts, multi-page pagination) are not represented in the P1 list above.

**Compliance-recommended checks (GDPR / SOX findings)**
- Confirm the footer text asset and version metadata contain no customer-identifying content — document-service, reporting-service.
- Confirm preview artefacts used for approval are access-controlled and disposed per retention expectations — document-service, reporting-service.
- Verify template publish/approval/rollback permissions are restricted to authorised roles, with authentication-service enforcing session/step-up checks and events recorded in audit-db.
- Confirm versioned change control, documented preview approval and rollback evidence before relying on the new version.
- Verify template publish, template selection and statement job events continue to append immutable records to audit-db with no field/retention changes.
- Reconcile a sample of rendered statements before/after to confirm financial figures, page numbering and multi-page continuity are unaffected — document-service, reporting-db.
- Confirm api-gateway routing, policy and tracing configuration is unchanged and no financial-data interface contracts with reporting-service are modified.
- Re-check that selecting the new template version adds no personal-data flows through reporting-service or reporting-db.

**Post-deployment verification items (deployment_notes)**
- Statements render the approved footer; previous template version remains selectable for rollback; no changes to customer, card, or financial data, auth flow, or external API contracts.
